decisions: REUSE urlToOptions (connectionRecord delegates to it for bracket stripping, numeric port, pathname+search path and colon-joined auth; only maps absent port/auth to null)
notes:
connectionRecord parses with new URL (which throws on invalid or relative input) and reuses the existing urlToOptions helper, mapping its optional port/auth to null. The 2 WARN findings from gw check matched urlToOptions itself; they are resolved with a documented allow-duplicate comment because the new function wraps urlToOptions and does not copy it. The patch also includes the .groundwork/ files that gw init created, since git add -A picks them up.
